title: Added Days Before Sale for Established Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Customers
content:
Established customers get added days before the sale of a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, following the installment payments posted on the contract. Returned payments are counted from the payments returned with a return date after the same calendar day twelve months before the mailing date of the notice of intent to sell, up to and including the mailing date.

| Installment payments posted | Returned payment in the counted twelve months | Added days |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more (the long-standing count) | none | 10 (the long-standing days) |
| 24 or more | one or more | 5 (the established days) |
| 12 to 23 (at least the established count) | any | 5 |
| Fewer than 12 | any | none |

### Hypothetical cases (mailing date 10 May of a year)

- 30 installment payments, last returned payment dated 10 May of the year before: that date is not after the same calendar day twelve months back, so it is not counted; 10 days are added.
- 30 installment payments, a payment returned on 11 May of the year before: counted; 5 days are added.
- 12 installment payments: 5 days. 11 installment payments: none.
